Sourcesrc/website/public/wasm/text-draw/luiskr_text_draw.js
UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

TextDraw

Public wasm surface — one text-draw canvas per animated block.

frame

frame — advance the clock, repack, draw all live chars.

  • @param dt Frame delta in seconds.
  • @returns false once the surface is stale/lost (JS disarms).
  • @param {number} dt
  • @returns {boolean}

init

init — device + pipeline + sampler; the bind group builds once the atlas + first sheet land (upload_atlas/set_chars → rebind).

  • @param canvas The overlay canvas.
  • @param device The shared GPUDevice (one per page, from the JS bridge).
  • @returns Ok on a live surface, Err(JsValue) on failure.
  • @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas
  • @param {GPUDevice} device

constructor

TextDraw::new — un-initialized widget; init must follow.

resize

resize — device px — the res uniform.

  • @param w @param h Backing size in device pixels.
  • @param {number} w
  • @param {number} h

set_chars

set_chars — upload the per-char sheet (12 f32s per char — see module doc). Recreates the storage buffer when the sheet outgrows capacity, then rebinds.

  • @param values The flat f32 sheet (len = count·12).
  • @returns The char count adopted (0 on malformed input).
  • @param {Float32Array} values
  • @returns {number}

set_ink

set_ink — push the text color (computed style read once).

  • @param r @param g @param b @param a rgba 0-1.
  • @param {number} r
  • @param {number} g
  • @param {number} b
  • @param {number} a

set_size

set_size — CSS px (contract parity; unused — device px only).

  • @param _w @param _h CSS size — unused.
  • @param {number} _w
  • @param {number} _h

trigger

trigger — start the stagger: the clock's current value becomes t0 so frame reports elapsed ms from HERE.

upload_atlas

upload_atlas — stage the rasterized char atlas. ImageBitmap input — copyExternalImageToTexture moves pixels GPU→GPU. Rebinds so the new atlas goes live next frame.

  • @param bitmap The decoded atlas bitmap.
  • @returns true when the texture landed, false before init.
  • @param {ImageBitmap} bitmap
  • @returns {boolean}
